additional_info.subject: Immediate Action for Customer
additional_info.body:
Together with the Region we confirmed that the issue is caused by the roof and excluded the housing as possible faulty.
Region France knows which spare part to order and was asked to send the faulty roof back to the return center so SQM & the supplier can continue with the root cause analysis.
Acc. to the Region the spare-roof arrived on 12.03.2025 and exchange of the roof needs to be scheduled.
